description: NEX Collection DNA — per ADR-0027 Rule #11. Each collection carries its own transformation policy (allowed_types, default_sizes, allows_text/prices/whatsapp/logo, requires_transparent). Inherited by every image in the collection. When a user asks 'make me a hero image' or 'make me a Black Friday advert' for a collection, NEX loads the policy here and asks zero questions.
